svg.title: Torpedo Boat - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: High Guard Update 2022, printed 152-153, PDF 153-154. Combined decks retain flat chamfered bow, long narrow hull, swept aft wings with upright tip profiles and stepped paired-drive stern. Smaller bridge deck fits forward hull using matching grid/beam and illustration; alignment interpreted. Illustration corroborates aft side structures. Torpedo drawings and internal room outlines excluded.
